description: Land Acquisition - Midellawala, Mirigama D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire multiple land lots for public purpose (Central Expressway). It contains descriptions of specific land parcels, their locations, extents, and claimant information, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land acquisition matters.
